 caret-right Sport | Basketball Trump slams NBA star LeBron James for disrespecting US national anthem
 NBA superstar LeBron James criticised by US President ⁠Donald ⁠Trump for disrespectful behaviour during national anthem. 
 Listen Listen (1 min) Save
 Share Trump slams NBA star LeBron James for disrespecting US national anthem on social media share-nodes Share
 facebook x whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James on the basketball court during a break in a game against the New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden in New York City, the United States [Brad Penner-Imagn Images/Reuters] By Reuters Published On 22 Oct 2026 22 Oct 2026 US President Donald ⁠Trump criticised ⁠National Basketball Association (NBA) superstar LeBron James on Thursday for what he called disrespectful behaviour during the singing of the ⁠US national anthem at a recent NBA game.
 “While listening to our National Anthem, LeBron James disrespects our Country,” Trump ⁠said in a Truth Social post accompanied by a video showing James moving his body during the anthem.

 The clip Trump shared showed James standing in line with the members of the Philadelphia 76ers, swinging his arms in a warm-up-type stretch and performing basketball shooting movements.
 A representative for the 76ers ⁠did not immediately respond to a ⁠request from Al Jazeera for comment.
 Trump has repeatedly criticised athletes for their behaviour during pre-game renditions of the US national anthem, notably beginning with NFL quarterback Colin Kaepernick’s ⁠kneeling protest in support of racial justice.
 Trump cancelled the planned White House visit of ⁠the Super Bowl champions Philadelphia Eagles ⁠in 2018 after the team disagreed with his call for players to stand during the anthem.
 James became a leading voice in the Black Lives ‌Matter movement in 2020 and has frequently supported progressive issues as he ascended to the top of the NBA’s all-time ‌scoring ‌list.
